units_checked.description: ids of every commit unit in your batch that you judged

findings.description: exactly one entry per unit in units_checked

unit.description: the unit id from the batch file, e.g. commit:1a2b3c4d

kind.description: covered: user-visible and the NEWS top section describes it; missing: user-visible and not described; not user-visible: refactor, tests, comments, internal speed-up with identical results; unclear: cannot tell

text.description: one or two sentences: what a user would notice (or why nothing), and for covered the NEWS bullet that describes it

news_section.description: for missing: the NEWS subsection the line belongs in (Breaking changes, Bug fixes, New features, Performance, Documentation, ...); else empty

news_line.description: for missing: a drafted NEWS bullet in the style of the existing ones, starting with * ; else empty
